reviews.text: Stay connected. My addiction/disease took me on a 30 year journey of really high ups and the lowest of lows. On April 19, 2025 at 8:33 PM I put down my last shot and then my last hit that I’ll ever have in my life and called my mother to bring me to the hospital or I was going to die. I died that night twice in front of her at the hospital and had a toe amputated 3 days later. I had lost 94lbs in 7months and in her own words was “unrecognizable “! When I woke up from surgery I grabbed my iPad that I had and looked up rehabs right away and then installed this app. Without this app, AA, rehab, coming in the form of Green Mountain Treatment Center, and the unconditional love of a mother to her oldest son I would not be here today writing this. I am currently staying at the Freemen House for men in Dover NH and just got my 6 month coin the other day. I completed my rehab August 21st of this past year and went from rehab right to prison in the same day, which in itself was a blessing most likely, and I say that because I was riding high on that “pink cloud” as it’s referred to and even though I was only in prison for 2 months , it was a reminder on what my life looked like or could still look like if it wasn’t for sobriety. So stay connected and really utilize this app because you’re worth it , and I’m proof that if I can do it so can you. God bless and always keep fighting the good fight even if it knocks you down.

I ❤️sober sidekick!!
I don’t remember how I found this or if it came recommended, but I started sober sidekick very early in my recovery when I still had memory loss and cloudy brain, and short focus span. And now over a year later, It is very much a part of my morning routine before I leave for my day. It wakes me up, it puts a smile on my heart and pep in my walk because I get to encourage and be encouraged from the very first read. I get uplifted in my thoughts and focused on staying on the solution and positive energy. I’m forever grateful for the team and for Chris Thompson for creating such a powerful and impactful community through this app. I pray we get to meet one day so I can thank him and his team. And it’s so cool he shares his recovery too!! Such an inspiration. 
In my dream, make a wish world, we would partner up and go on recovery revivals around the world just empowering others to join us on the fabulous recovery train! That would be so sweet!! But I’ll start with meeting him would be amazing!! Thank you so much all who are here and contributing to the sober sidekick community!! Grateful oh so grateful!!
